summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, reporting its unaudited results for the six months ended July 3, 2026. The filing includes interim financial metrics such as revenue of €10,724 million, operating profit of €1,458 million, and diluted EPS of €2.17, with an interim dividend of €0.82 per share. The report is a routine periodic earnings disclosure and contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change. It is filed solely to incorporate results into existing registration statements, making it a standard reporting obligation with no transactional or strategic catalyst.
